source.task: Record verified gotchas from the PR #4141 auto-close-of-#3930 incident and the #4137 events.jsonl investigation: GitHub's keyword scanner is quote-blind (not just negation-blind), auto-merge fires on any post-arm push with no review window, and events.jsonl presence-vs-content plus the GitHub false-positive CONFLICTING mechanism

title: Arming auto-merge does not freeze a PR to its current commits -- any later push can merge within under a minute, with no review window
